paragraphs.text: Local GigaAM (Sber) Russian speech recognition provider for DeepSeek Harness voice input
# dsh-speech-to-text-gigaam

Local **Russian speech recognition for DeepSeek Harness**, powered by
Sber GigaAM v3 E2E RNNT.
Punct
uation and capitalisation are included. Audio and transcripts stay on the host.
## Install and prepare — no terminal required

1. In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and install
`https://github.com/kelvmg/dsh-speech-to-text-g

igaam`. Enable the bundle.
2. Open voice settings, select **GigaAM v3 · Russian (punctuation)** and

`ru` or `auto`.
3. Click **Download and prepare**. The plugin installs its own Python, PyTorch,
Giga

AM, audio tools and recognition model. Progress, cancellation and retry are
available in the existin

g voice preparation card.
4. Start dictation once preparation finishes.

**Automatic setup in 0.4.0 supports macOS on Apple Silicon (arm64, macOS 13+).**
No system Python, H

omebrew, git or separately installed ffmpeg is required.
Other platforms fail with an explicit expla

nation before downloading anything;
advanced users can provide a prepared interpreter with `pythonPa

th`.
Intel Mac is not supported by automatic setup: its last official PyTorch build
conflicts with t
he current GigaAM NumPy requirements.

Requires DSH with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle` and Node 20.3+
(the DSH host su

pplies Node). Reserve **4 GB disk**, approximately **2 GB RAM**;
initial setup normally takes **3–20
minutes**, depending on the network and machine.
## What preparation does

Activation only checks local resources: **no background downloads or installers**.
The existing `che
ck → model → verify → load` preparation contract is retained.

- **Check:** download SHA-256-verified uv 0.9.7, install private CPython 3.11.14,
create a private e

nvironment and install the checked-in dependency lockfile with
`--require-hashes`. PyTorch and torch

audio are both 2.8.0. GigaAM source is pinned
to commit `7447938d791c4f3e643386ee22c33777004293a5` a

nd SHA-256 verified.
ffmpeg comes from `imageio-ffmpeg==0.6.0`, not a system package manager.
- **Mo

del:** download `v3_e2e_rnnt.ckpt` (448,929,252 bytes) and tokenizer
(255,336 bytes) from Sber's CDN

. This is the only guided model.
- **Verify:** verify sizes, the checkpoint's upstream MD5 and token

izer SHA-256.
- **Load:** warm up the model using the configured device. Inference and warmup
share
a single process queue.
Files persist under `~/.dsh/speech-to-text/gigaam`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

An interrupted installation never creates a readiness marker. Retry reuses valid
archives, downloade

d Python and package cache. Completed models are reused too;
a partially downloaded model starts ove

r (HTTP Range resume is not implemented).
Preparation has a heartbeat lock to prevent overlapping se

ssions. After a host
crash, a stale lock expires within two minutes; retry then.

**Upgrade from 0.3:** existing `models/` are reused; the old manually created
`venv/` is left untouc

hed. The default moves to `runtime/venv/`, so click
**Download and prepare** once after updating. To

retain a manually prepared
interpreter instead, explicitly set its absolute `pythonPath`.
## Network, privacy and integrity

Setup contacts GitHub (uv, pinned standalone Python and GigaAM source),
`pypi.org`/`files.pythonhost

ed.org` (Python distributions) and
`cdn.chatwm.opensmodel.sberdevices.ru` (recognition model). The s

ource selector in
voice settings applies **only to model files**, not runtime dependencies.

Runtime archives, source and locked Python distributions are verified against
pinned hashes. uv veri

fies standalone Python using its pinned download catalog.
Python build tooling still uses isolated b

uild environments and the HTTPS PyPI
index; this is not a completely hermetic/offline build. Setup d

oes not alter
system Python, shell profiles or global PATH. Ambient pip/uv configuration and
`IMAGEI

O_FFMPEG_EXE` do not override managed setup; normal certificate/proxy
settings remain usable.

Downloads have deadlines and exact byte caps; corrupt or partial files are not
published as final as

sets. Cancel kills the process group and waits for process
exit before deleting temporary audio or s

tarting another job. Recordings are
transcribed locally and temporary WAV/transcript files are remov

ed afterwards.
Errors write diagnostic traces to `dsh-gigaam-stt.log` in the system temp directory.
No audio, transcript or telemetry is uploaded.
## Configuration
Defaults are in `cordis.patch.yml`; advanced options on `speech-to-text-gigaam`:
| Option | Default / purpose |

| `dataRoot` | `~/.dsh/speech-to-text/gigaam` |
| `pythonPath` | `dataRoot/runtime/venv/bin/python`;

an explicit path disables managed installs |
| `downloadRoot` | `dataRoot/models` |
| `model` | `v3

_e2e_rnnt`; other models require an externally prepared environment and cache |
| `device` | `cpu`;

`auto` may choose MPS; only CPU is smoke-tested |
| `maxChunkSeconds` | `20`; clamped to `3…24.5`; e

very sample is retained |
| `timeoutMs` | `900000` per recognition/warmup job |
| `setupTimeoutMs` |

`1800000` per installer command/download |
| `downloadTimeoutMs` | `900000` per model download |
|

`downloadSources` | Sber CDN origin; additional trusted model mirrors are optional |
| `loadModel` |
`true`; disable only for diagnostics/tests |

Unsupported guided models fail before any installation. An explicit custom
`pythonPath` must already

contain all dependencies and ffmpeg; the plugin never
installs packages into a user-specified inter

n all dependencies and ffmpeg; the plugin never
installs packages into a user-specified interpreter.
## Development and headless preparation
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`GIGAAM_DATA_ROOT=/absolute/test-directory` selects an independent data root for
headless preparatio

n and smoke tests. `python/setup.sh` is a compatibility wrapper
for the same Node-based preparation;

it no longer calls system Python or git.
The dependency lockfile can be regenerated using pinned uv

with
`uv pip compile --generate-hashes --no-header --no-annotate` from
`python/requirements-macos-a
rm64.in`; update the lock digest in the manifest too.
## Changelog

- **0.4.0** — one-click isolated Python/dependency/audio-tool setup on Apple Silicon;
pinned runtime

/source and hashed dependency lock; cache reuse, cancel/retry and
honest resource estimates. Fix inf

inite/oversized chunking and lost short tails,
queued cancellation, child-reaping/cleanup races, war

mup serialization and device
